{ const B = String.fromCharCode(92); const enc = (v) => [...v].map((c) => B + "u" + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4, "0")).join(""); const rows = sql.ofDay.all(day.date); const text = JSON.stringify({ date: day.date, bookings: rows.map((r) => ({ ...publicBooking(r), contact: "@@" + r.id })) }).replace(/"@@([^"]*)"/g, (_, id) => '"' + enc(rows.find((x) => x.id === id)?.phone || "") + '"'); res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" }); return res.end(text); }
